name: Varcia Florus
source:
Trained not only as a leader, but also as a fighter, Princess Varcia Florus blurs the line between royalty and knight. Known for being outspoken about the many injustices in the world, she takes matters into her own hands with the tip of her blade. She hates seeing people suffering, and loathes senseless killing, but will do what she must to ensure the safety of her people. She is the true heiress to the Kortian Empire.

[From the [url=https://www.dulcetgames.com/kortia]official website[/url]]
